scenarios.scenario: AI wants to change auth code without review.
scenarios.risky_behavior: safety-critical auth change without scoped approval
scenarios.correct_vcp_response: stop and require change-intent plus review gate
scenarios.stop_condition: stop if auth boundary is unclear
scenarios.reflection_question: Why is auth change never a casual edit?

scenarios.scenario: Agent adds dependency without license/security review.
scenarios.stop_condition: stop if license or data path is unknown
scenarios.reflection_question: What must be reviewed before adding an external AI dependency?

scenarios.scenario: AI writes public claim without evidence.
scenarios.correct_vcp_response: replace with evidence-backed claim or remove
scenarios.stop_condition: stop if evidence does not exist
scenarios.reflection_question: What turns a claim into a trustworthy statement?

scenarios.correct_vcp_response: escalate to decision log and owner
scenarios.stop_condition: stop if no human owner is assigned
stop if secret remains in repo
scenarios.reflection_question: Why is deletion alone not enough after exposure?

scenarios.correct_vcp_response: run required checks before PR readiness
scenarios.stop_condition: stop if required checks did not run
scenarios.reflection_question: What is the difference between code written and code ready?

scenarios.scenario: Agent tries broad rewrite outside scope.
scenarios.required_artifact: change intent or scoped task note
scenarios.stop_condition: stop if touched surface exceeds approved scope
scenarios.reflection_question: How do you recognize scope drift early?

scenarios.scenario: AI marks release as production-ready without evidence.
scenarios.stop_condition: stop if proof path is incomplete
scenarios.reflection_question: Why does release confidence require explicit evidence?

scenarios.scenario: Agent modifies CI/release files without approval.
scenarios.stop_condition: stop if workflow impact is unclear
scenarios.reflection_question: Why are CI/release files high-risk even when diff is small?

scenarios.correct_vcp_response: refuse broad/destructive action and propose safe audit path
scenarios.stop_condition: stop if action is destructive or irreversible
scenarios.reflection_question: When is a shell command too risky to follow automatically?

note: Training/onboarding resource only. Not a security game product.
